notes: The KiCad ending (storyboard 4b, decisions 0028, 0030 and 0036): desktop recordings of the editors the app opened, each put in where the take clicked its button. First the schematic editor (Open in KiCad, kicad.mp4), then the PCB editor (Open PCB, kicad-pcb.mp4).
Times are seconds from the start of each clip. At zoom.start the clip cuts to a crop of the same recorded frames around the title block (labelled 'zoomed in'); nothing is redrawn.

zoom.cx/cy: the title block's centre as a fraction of the captured area, measured on a maximized KiCad 9 window at 1920x1020. Schematic: HL-HW-26-0049, 2026-11-22; cy raised 2026-11-24 so the crop ends above the status bar. PCB: HL-HW-26-0042, 2026-11-26; cy kept above pcbnew's status bar too. Re-check the frames if KiCad's layout changes.
label: KiCad 9 on the desktop (screen recording)
